_note: Fighters in depth: the core's numbers (sim/core/depth.gd; docs/architecture/depth-core.md). Depths and speeds are in fighter heights (1 bh is 75 units). Every number is a first value from docs/design/depth.md, and none has been run in a match. The director's own depth numbers join this file in its window.
_enabled: the one switch. SimCore.newMatch copies it into S.depthOn unless the match's setup has its own "depth". Off until the director's depth window: with it off nothing below is read by a match, and this file is not in a replay's data hash
_maxBhPerSec: the cap: the most a drift in depth moves a fighter, outside a flight or a rush. It holds the capped velocity (Fighter.vz) and a free fighter's ease to his home depth (depth.md section 3)
_faceMarginBh: a fighter outside a flight keeps his centre this far from a standing building's face, and so from a kerb line where a block stands. The body's own half extents (lanes.json body) are the least it can be
_capExempt: the causes of depth the cap does not hold: SimFighter.addDepth puts them in the exempt velocity (Fighter.vzX). The causes are push, carry, home, magnet, shove, sidestep and giveGround. A knock-back is one motion along the line (Game Design's ruling). The sidestep is assumed exempt and a give-ground step capped until Game Design rules on them
